nodes.name: kick
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a punchy kick drum via a 150→45Hz pitch-dropping sine body plus a noise click transient, giving the drop its 4-on-the-floor drive.

crux.code:
freq = 150 * np.exp(-t * 30) + 45       # pitch drop 150->45Hz
    body = np.sin(2 * np.pi * np.cumsum(freq) / sr)
    click = np.random.uniform(-1, 1, n) * np.exp(-t * 200) * 0.3
    e = np.exp(-t * 12)
    return (body * e + click) * gain

    body = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 180 * t) * np.exp(-t * 25)
    e = np.exp(-t * 18)
    return (noise * 0.7 + body * 0.4) * e * gain

nodes.signature: def supersaw(freq, dur, sr=SR, detune=0.008, gain=0.3)
nodes.summary: Synthesizes a supersaw stab by stacking 7 slightly detuned sawtooth oscillators, producing the thick future-bass chord stabs.

for i in range(7):
        d = 1 + (i - 3) * detune
        ph = np.cumsum(freq * d) / sr
        out += (2 * (ph - np.floor(0.5 + ph)))  # sawtooth
    out /= 7

const m = text.match(/^category:\s*(\w+)/m);
  return m ? m[1] : fallback || 'misc';

nodes.name: parseEstHours
nodes.summary: Extracts the est_hours estimate from item text, defaulting to 999 so unestimated work sorts last in the batch ranking.

crux.code:
const m = text.match(/^est_hours:\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/m);
  return m ? parseFloat(m[1]) : 999;

nodes.name: parseFrontmatter
nodes.summary: Converts a markdown file's YAML frontmatter block into a key/value object, normalizing quotes and nulls, so item metadata drives batch selection.

nodes.name: parsePriority
nodes.summary: Reads an item's priority label, defaulting to P3 so unprioritized work ranks lowest in selection.

crux.code:
const m = text.match(/^priority:\s*(P\d|[A-Z]+)/m);
  return m ? m[1] : 'P3';

nodes.name: parseStatus
nodes.summary: Reads an item's status field so already-shipped work can be filtered out of the batch.

crux.code:
const m = text.match(/^status:\s*(\w+)/m);
  return m ? m[1] : 'unknown';

nodes.name: priorityRank
nodes.summary: Maps P0/P1/P2 priority labels to numeric ranks so sorting ships the most urgent items first.

nodes.name: roundRobin
nodes.summary: Interleaves items across category buckets so the 40-item batch is functionally diverse instead of clustering one department back-to-back.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.summary: Recursively scans the roadmap items tree for in_progress items not already queued or excluded, collecting them as top-up candidates to fill the batch to 40.
